summary: This is a Phase 1 study to test how a new medicine called NNC0638-0355 works in adults who are living with overweight or obesity. Participants will receive either the study medicine or a dummy medicine that looks the same but has no active ingredients, given as an injection under the skin. The study has a status of Active, not recruiting and includes 63 participants. Novo Nordisk A/S is the sponsor for the research.
